environment.description: Same application deployed in namespace 'sre-tools-hardened' on the same EKS cluster. Container uses distroless base image (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian12). Namespace has a Cilium NetworkPolicy with L7 HTTP-aware filtering: egress is restricted to DNS (port 53 to kube-dns only) and HTTPS to an internal allow-list of IPs. Additionally, the pod spec includes an ephemeral container debug profile with a Seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) AND an AppArmor profile (runtime/default) loaded via annotation 'container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/diag=runtime/default'. The Cilium L7 policy includes a rule that inspects process-level context via identity-aware enforcement: only connections initiated by /usr/bin/dig, /usr/bin/ping (via ICMP type 8 allowance at L3), and /usr/bin/nslookup binaries are permitted egress. The distroless image does NOT include curl, traceroute, bash, sh, or any other shell binary. The OPA Gatekeeper constraint 'K8sDisallowedCapabilities' drops ALL capabilities including NET_RAW (ping uses unprivileged ICMP via net.ipv4.ping_group_range sysctl). A ValidatingAdmissionPolicy additionally enforces that no container in this namespace may set securityContext.privileged=true or add capabilities.

egress_l7.process_identity: only /usr/bin/dig and /usr/bin/nslookup permitted to open sockets
